references.text: Jesus gives the disciples power to drive out unclean spirits.
Jesus commands the disciples to make all nations into disciples, teach them, and baptize them.
On Pentecost day, the disciples were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues.
Gentiles speak in tongues and praise God, showing that they have received the Holy Spirit.
Paul drives out a spirit of divination from a woman.
When Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
